intro: The severed head of Twilight Lord Kelris serves as undeniable proof that the leader of the Twilight's Hammer within Blackfathom Deeps has fallen. Carried out from the corrupted temple ruins, it is sought by representatives of the Argent Dawn to confirm the end of his profane ritual sacrifices.

p: Within the submerged depths of the sunken Temple of Elune, Twilight Lord Kelris orchestrated dark sacrifices to Aku'mai, a monstrous pet of the Old Gods. Claiming his head marks the end of his tyrannical leadership over the Twilight's Hammer cultists and their naga allies in the cavern. The grisly trophy must be carried back to surface civilizations to assure leaders that Kelris's bloody ceremonies have finally ceased.

For months, Kelris was presumed dead or lost by the Argent Dawn, only for his sinister influence to resurface alongside Kalimdor's encroaching shadows. When presented to agents in Darnassus or Thunder Bluff, the head settles lingering bounties and confirms that his attempts to plunge the world back into primeval chaos have been thwarted.
